problem: UAOS already owned cognition, root-scope, evolution and problem-closure semantics, but ChatGPT conversational execution and UAOS-managed runtimes did not share one finalization seam that composed those owners and prevented a candidate final response from being emitted while actionable work or required evidence remained.

competing_hypotheses.support: Repeated mistakes can look like insufficient architecture/SOP knowledge.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: The repository already contained a single canonical cognition kernel, executable root-scope admission, typed evolution disposition and fail-closed problem closure; the repeated escapes occurred after those mechanisms existed.

competing_hypotheses.support: Rolling observations, records and repeated continuation turns created visible governance overhead and at times made the user a workflow clock.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: Reducing prose alone would not make a final response fail closed when executable work or evidence was still missing.

competing_hypotheses.support: Cognition, problem closure and session adherence were separately executable, but before PR #49 no runtime function composed them into one pre-emit admission decision and no OpenAI Agents adapter attached that decision as an output guardrail.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: The production repair reuses the existing owners instead of creating a new cognition or control plane, and regression/live tests prove the composed gate can admit and reject candidate finalization deterministically.

competing_hypotheses.support: Custom Instructions apply across ChatGPT conversations and are useful for stable bootstrap behavior.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: OpenAI documents Custom Instructions as instructions supplied to ChatGPT and states there is no Custom Instructions API; this does not establish an application-controlled pre-send validator.

competing_hypotheses.support: OpenAI Agents SDK output guardrails run on final agent output and tripwires halt the controlled run path.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: The guarantee is explicitly bounded to runs that attach the guardrail and is not projected onto the native ChatGPT product host.

external_evidence: OpenAI Help Center: Custom Instructions apply across chats, are user-editable instructions, and have no Custom Instructions API.
OpenAI Agents SDK: output guardrails validate final agent output and a triggered tripwire halts the controlled run.

production_change.mechanism: Existing problem closure and session adherence are composed at one runtime finalization seam. Finalization fails closed when actionable work remains without user input, problem closure is not terminal, cognition/evolution evidence is missing, or the final progress report is inconsistent. Controlled OpenAI Agents runs may attach the same gate as a blocking output guardrail.
production_change.anti_bloat: No second cognition state machine, no second controller, no new progress-report field, and no duplicated full policy in Custom Instructions.

verified_behaviors: A selected clean response can finalize only after required progress-report consistency passes.
Finalization is blocked while actionable work remains and no genuine user input is required.
A problem response requires an admissible terminal problem-closure decision; an available authorized repair cannot finalize as recommendation-only.
Problem finalization binds to typed RootScopeReceipt, EvolutionDisposition and required durable problem evidence through the existing adherence evaluator.
A genuine user-choice blocker can terminate as BLOCKED_WITH_REASON without fabricating cognition admission that could not yet be completed.
The OpenAI Agents adapter forwards output guardrails and the UAOS guardrail builder admits or trips deterministically.
The live contract suite installed the real openai-agents dependency and passed the installed-SDK guardrail compatibility tests without requiring a model network call.
PostgreSQL/DBOS recovery probes and object-store roundtrip remained successful after the runtime change.
assurance_boundary: UAOS-controlled runtime paths can now fail closed when they invoke the finalization gate, and the OpenAI Agents SDK adapter is compatible with a blocking output guardrail. The native ChatGPT product still has no verified repository-controlled pre-send hook, so Custom Instructions remain bootstrap-only and live native-chat adherence remains an observation boundary. The 2026-10-17 recurrence observation confirms this residual boundary is active in real use rather than merely theoretical.
remaining_scope: Continue native ChatGPT selected-context observation without claiming physical mediation; repeated native recurrence is durable evidence, not a reason to duplicate cognition rules.

If a controlled UAOS application is deployed, attach build_uaos_output_guardrail to every user-visible final Agent run; internal reasoning-only runs need not carry the progress-report finalization contract.
Do not claim this evolution can physically repair native ChatGPT output mediation until an actual host hook becomes available and is verified.
